task: Implement M.SCHD-T42 in MindAttic.Scheduler: overnight jobs auto-arrange (never two starting at once, heaviest first from 00:00, staggered, all finished by 08:00) unless pinned; an Optimize action in the WPF dashboard; every job run recorded in a new Azure SQL db MindAttic.Scheduler (built and tested locally on LocalDB first, then deployed). The full approved plan is at C:\Users\ryand\.claude-accounts\pdftransferjr@mindattic.com\plans\resilient-seeking-kay.md; read it first.
decisions: Approved by the owner: (1) Run history goes in Azure SQL, a new db MindAttic.Scheduler on sql-mindattic-f65744 (rg-mindattic-data, Basic tier, billed about $0.16/day because the 10 free slots are used; confirm the cost with the owner right before az sql db create). Local dev uses (localdb)\MSSQLLocalDB. Connection order: MINDATTIC_SCHEDULER_SQL env var, then %APPDATA%\MindAttic\MindAttic.Scheduler\database.json {"SqlServer":...}, then LocalDB. Copy MindAttic.Tickets/src/MindAttic.Tickets/Data/EntraTokenCache.cs for the service-principal token; packages Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 6.1.7 and Azure.Identity 1.21.0. (2) Sequencing: staggered start times plus a one-at-a-time named-mutex lock in a run wrapper; an overrunning job makes the next one wait. (3) What arranges: jobs.json {"daily":"auto"} = arranged; any explicit HH:mm = pinned and never moved. Migrate the 7 overnight jobs (Launcher.NightlyBackup, JellyFinPoster.Refresh, Prose.GLMZ.Wiki.Sync, Azure.BackupNightly, GridGame.Nightly, IdiotProof.DataMirror, Azure.BackupWeekly) to auto. Daytime market jobs, every-N jobs, atLogon jobs and keepRunning daemons are left alone. Arranged times live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MindAttic\Scheduler\arrangement.json, not jobs.json. (4) Heaviness = average of the last 10 successful measured runs, else the job field "estimate", else 15 min. New console app src/MindAttic.Scheduler.Cli (mindattic-scheduler.exe), verbs: run <job> [--exclusive] -- <cmd> (wraps console jobs via install.ps1 New-JobAction; spools to %LOCALAPPDATA%\MindAttic\Scheduler\spool.jsonl if the db is unreachable; returns the child exit code), arrange [--optimize] [--dry-run] [--json], db migrate (the only DDL), runs [--json]. A nightly Scheduler.Arrange job is pinned at 23:30. The optimizer never starts a job on a minute an every-N job fires. Tests: per the repo rule they run only when asked; the plan says run the new suites once locally before the Azure step.
